questions.q: A motorist uses 12% of his fuel to cover 18% of his total journey for non-city driving conditions. He knows that he has to cover another 24% of his total journey in non-city driving conditions. What should be the percentage decrease in his fuel efficiency for city driving over non-city driving, so that he just completes his entire journey without a refill?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio) & Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Non-city aur City ki alag alag efficiency nikalni hai. Jo ratio distance aur fuel ka aayega, bas uske fraction me decrease percentage nikalna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Non-city efficiency find kar aur remaining components se City ki efficiency. Aur unka percentage shift evaluate maar.

Mathematically :-
$$ NC_{dist} = 18\\% + 24\\% = 42\\% \\\\ NC_{fuel} = 12\\% + 16\\% = 28\\% \\\\ E_{NC} = \\frac{42}{28} = \\frac{3}{2} \\\\ C_{dist} = 58\\%, \\ C_{fuel} = 72\\% \\\\ E_{C} = \\frac{58}{72} = \\frac{29}{36} \\\\ \\% \\Delta = \\frac{\\frac{3}{2} - \\frac{29}{36}}{\\frac{3}{2}} \\times 100 = 46.29\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Approximation & Range Definition ka use kiya karo exam me. Exact calculation me time waste nahi!

Mathematically :-
$$ \\% \\Delta = \\frac{54 - 29}{54} \\times 100 = \\frac{25}{54} \\times 100 \\\\ \\approx \\frac{25}{50} \\times 100 = 50\\% \\ (Closest \\ 46\\%) $$

Exam Takeaway: Variables jab completely percentage me given ho, wahan denominator comparison se approximate answers detect kiye jate hain.

questions.q: The price of an article decreased by 8% every year. If the difference between the price at the end of the third and fourth year is 69, then 40% of the price at the end of the second year is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: 3rd aur 4th year ke beech ka difference purely 3rd year ki value ka 8% hi toh hoga! Piche calculate karna hai (reverse successive). Digital sum ya multiples check kar sakte ho, par calculation aasan hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $8\% \text{ of } P_3 = 69 \implies P_3 = \frac{6900}{8}$. Ab $P_3$ aaya kaise? $P_2$ me 8% ghata ke, yaani $P_2 \times 0.92 = P_3$. Toh $P_2 = \frac{6900}{8 \times 0.92}$. Humein $40\%$ (yaani 0.4) of $P_2$ chahiye: $0.4 \times \frac{6900}{8 \times 0.92} = 375$. Calculation ko end tak hold kar!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let starting price be P. $P_3 = P \times (0.92)^3$. Difference $P_3 - P_4 = P_3 - P_3(0.92) = P_3(0.08) = 69$. Step by step nikalne me time waste hota hai, seedha reverse shift lagao.

Best Exam Approach: Method 1, combined with intermediate step skipping.

questions.q: Vikas has Rs.x. He gave 44.44% of Rs.x to Anju. Anju bought 33.33% of the money she got from Vikas for a dress and donated 31.25% of the remaining amount. The remaining amount is saved by (y). If the amount donated is 1250, then find the value of (x-y).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Ye pure fraction chain ka chakkar hai. $44.44\% = \frac{4}{9}$, $33.33\% = \frac{1}{3}$, aur $31.25\% = \frac{5}{16}$. Branches ko pakad ke bas link karta ja!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, sequence utha le: Anju ko mila $\frac{4}{9}x$.
Dress pe uda diye $\frac{1}{3}$, bache hue $\frac{2}{3}$.
Toh Remaining amount aaya $= \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{4}{9}x = \frac{8}{27}x$.
Donation hua $31.25\%$ yani remaining ka $\frac{5}{16}$ part.
Donation $= \frac{5}{16} \times \frac{8}{27}x = \frac{5}{54}x$. Aur yehi 1250 hai.
$\frac{5}{54}x = 1250 \implies x = 13500$.
Ab Save $(y)$ hua bacha hua $\frac{11}{16}$ hissa.
$y = \frac{11}{16} \times \frac{8}{27}x = \frac{11}{54}x$.
Value rakh $y = \frac{11}{54} \times 13500 = 2750$.
Pucha kya hai? $x - y = 13500 - 2750 = 10750$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek bade percentage wale lambaue sawal ko tu single equation ratios me baant sakta hai jo tezi se cancel ho jaati hai.

Exam Takeaway: Ajeeb fractions jaise $31.25\% = 5 \times 6.25\% = \frac{5}{16}$ rate hue hone chahiye warna waqt bekar kharab hoga.

questions.q: The population of a town is 3,11,250. The ratio of women to men is 43:40. If there are 24% literate among men and 8% literate among women, the total number of literate persons in the town is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Weighted Average

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Pura lamba chauda number 3,11,250 dekh ke darna mat. Ratio dekho: Total 83 parts = 311250. 83 ek prime hai, toh pakka perfectly katega. Base value nikal aur apply kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... W = 43x, M = 40x. Total 83x = 311250 $\implies$ x = 3750 (unit digit se hint le, $3 \times 5 = 15$). Literate Men = $24\%$ of $40x = 9.6x$. Literate Women = $8\%$ of $43x = 3.44x$. Total literate = $13.04x$. Total = $13.04 \times 3750 = 48900$. Digital Sum check: 13.04 (DS=8) * 3750 (DS=6) = 48 -> DS=3. Options me check kar, 48900 ka DS = 4+8+9=21 -> 3. Match!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard tarika yahi hai bas bacche pehle population ko exact men/women me todte hain, phir percentage nikalte hain. Wo 'Maha-Paap' hai.

Future Exam Takeaway: Variables (x) me hi percentage calculate kar aur end me multiply kar. CDS me time bachana hi asli game hai!

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was $50,000$. He used to spend on Family expenses (E), Taxes (T), Charity (C), and the rest were his savings. E was $60\%$ of the income, T was $20\%$ of E, and C was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T becomes $30\%$ of E and C becomes $20\%$ of T. The difference between the two savings (in Rs)?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, lag raha hai bada question hai par yaha multiple base aur sub-percentages hain. Digital sum lagane se accha single percentage me inko sum up karke udaya jaye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Tree bna ke calculation simple rakh. Sub-percentages ko add karke ek combined multiplier nikal le. Mathematically :- $$ S_1 = [100\% - (60\% + 12\% + 1.8\%)] \times 50000 \\ S_1 = 26.2\% \times 50000 = 13100 \\ \text{New Inc} = 140\% \times 50000 = 70000 \\ S_2 = [100\% - (60\% + 18\% + 3.6\%)] \times 70000 \\ S_2 = 18.4\% \times 70000 = 12880 \\ \text{Diff} = 13100 - 12880 = 220 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute rupees me convert karega toh lamba process hoga. Ye approach error-prone hai. Mathematically :- $$ E_1 = 30000 \implies T_1 = 6000 \implies C_1 = 900 \implies S_1 = 50000 - 36900 = 13100 \\ E_2 = 42000 \implies T_2 = 12600 \implies C_2 = 2520 \implies S_2 = 70000 - 57120 = 12880 \\ \text{Diff} = 13100 - 12880 = 220 $$

Exam Takeaway: Sub-percentages ko seedha unki parent percentages pe multiply karke base level pe add kar lene se equation ekdum patli ho jati hai.

StateSavings Percentage Calculation

B. New Savings2. $100\% - (60\% + 18\% + 3.6\%) = 18.4\%$

questions.q: Kartik saves $20 \%$ of his monthly income while he spends the remaining amount on food, rent, education, and shopping. He spends $15 \%$ of his income on food, while Rs. 12,800 is spent on rent, Rs. 32,000 on education, and Rs. 7,200 on shopping. The amount spent on shopping is $11.25 \%$ of the total expenditure. How much money (in Rs.) is spent on food?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dhyan de bhai, Shopping total expenditure ka $11.25 \%$ diya hai. Aur $11.25 \%$ fraction me $9/80$ hota hai. Waha se directly total expenditure aayega jisko reverse use karke Food ki value mil jayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Given percentage se independent unit nikalo, baki extra values faltu hain unko ignore karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Shopping} = 11.25 \% \text{ of Total Expenditure} \\ 7200 = \frac{9}{80} \times \text{Total Exp.} \\ \text{Total Exp.} = \frac{7200 \times 80}{9} = 64000 \\ \text{Savings} = 20 \%, \text{ so Exp.} = 80 \% \text{ of Income} \\ 80 \% \text{ of Income} = 64000 \implies 100 \% \text{ Income} = 80000 \\ \text{Food Spend} = 15 \% \text{ of } 80000 = 12000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional setup banakar variables dhundo par concept wahi rahega.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Income} = I \\ \text{Expenditure} = 0.8 I \\ \text{Shopping} = 0.1125 \times (0.8 I) = 7200 \\ \frac{1125}{10000} \times 0.8 I = 7200 \\ \frac{9}{80} \times \frac{4}{5} I = 7200 \\ \frac{36}{400} I = 7200 \implies I = \frac{7200 \times 400}{36} = 80000 \\ \text{Food} = 0.15 \times 80000 = 12000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Data trick me mat fasna! Rent aur Education ki given values totally irrelevant thi aur sirf time waste karne ke liye di gayi thi.

questions.q: If A's income is $20\%$ more than B's and B earns $\text{Rs. } 50,000$, what percent less is B's income than A's? (CHSL TIER I - 24/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yaha 50,000 sirf tera time waste karne ke liye diya hai! Jab options percentage me ho, toh actual value ka koi kaam nahi. A bada hai, wapas B pe aana hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha CPR thok! Increase hai $+20\% = +\frac{1}{5}$. Toh decrease hoga $-\frac{1}{6}$. Aur $\frac{1}{6}$ hota hai seedha $16.66\%$. Without pen solve hoga ye!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Inc} = +\frac{1}{5}$
$\text{Dec} = -\frac{1}{6} = 16.66\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan le B ki income 100 hai, toh A ki 120 hogi. B kitna kam hai? 20 kam hai. Par kis base pe? A ke base pe (120). Fraction bana de.

Mathematically :-
$A = 120$
$B = 100$
$\text{Diff} = 20$
$\% = \frac{20}{120} \times 100 = 16.66\%$

Exam Takeaway: Useless absolute values ko exam me humesha ignore marna seekh. Percentage to Percentage conversion me base shift kaam aata hai!

questions.q: Seventy-five percent of a number is 15 more than two-thirds of that number. Find the number. (CGL TIER I $\frac{16}{09}$/2025-S2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Fraction aur percentage ka amrit manthan hai. $75\%$ padhte hi dimaag me $\frac{3}{4}$ ghanti bajni chahiye. Fir $\frac{2}{3}$ aur $\frac{3}{4}$ ke denominator ko common banate hi sawal khatam.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Fractions decode kar aur unka denominator LCM $12$ par common kar de. Pen chhoona paap tha isme!

Mathematically :-
$$ \\frac{3}{4} \\ vs \\ \\frac{2}{3} \\\\ Base = 12 \\ units \\\\ 9 \\ units - 8 \\ units = 1 \\ unit \\\\ 1 \\ unit = 15 \\implies 12 \\ units = 180 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Algebra lagale. Simple par slow.

Mathematically :-
$$ 0.75x - \\frac{2}{3}x = 15 \\\\ \\frac{3x}{4} - \\frac{2x}{3} = 15 \\\\ \\frac{9x - 8x}{12} = 15 \\implies x = 180 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab decimals aur fractions mix hon, unko common fractional form aur LCM pe convert karke integers me baat karo.

questions.q: When the price of sugar increased by $53\%$, a family reduced its consumption per month such that the expenditure on sugar was only $19\%$ more than the earlier one. If the family consumed 38.7 kg sugar per month earlier, then what is the reduction in consumption of sugar per month?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi price aur expenditure alag-alag badhe, inverse ratio seedha hit karta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Nayi consumption / Purani consumption $= (100 + E\%) / (100 + P\%) = 119 / 153$. 17 se kaat de, aayega $7/9$. Yani pehle 9 unit khate the, ab 7 unit. Kami aayi 2 unit ki. Pehle ki value 9 unit $= 38.7$ kg, toh 1 unit $= 4.3$ kg. Toh 2 unit $= 2 \times 4.3 = 8.6$ kg.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Base 100 maan. 153 price ho gaya par pocket allow karti hai sirf 119 tak jana. Toh wapas aane ke liye $34/153$ ki kami karni padegi, yani $2/9$. $38.7$ ka $2/9$ sidha nikal le $= 8.6$ kg.

Exam Takeaway: Reverse ratio $E/P$ hamesha quantity deta hai, bas formula chat jaa.

questions.q: In a department $40\%$ of the employees are females. $60\%$ of the male employees know English. The total number of employees who know English is $66\%$. Find the percentage of females employees who know English.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, reverse deviation laga do. Data dekhte hi average ka deviation balance karna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Females $40\%$ (ratio 2), Males $60\%$ (ratio 3). Males ka average $60\%$, overall $66\%$. Reverse deviation se ud jayega! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Ratio (F:M)} = 2:3 \\ \text{Total Avg} = 66\% \\ \text{Male Avg} = 60\% \text{ (Deviation: } -6\%) \\ \text{Female}_{\%} = 66\% + \frac{3 \times 6}{2} = 66\% + 9\% = 75\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic weighted average ka equation. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Let Female } \% = x \\ 40x + 60(60) = 100(66) \\ 40x + 3600 = 6600 \\ 40x = 3000 \\ x = 75\% $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM reverse deviation saves calculation time in weighted average problems.

questions.q: After sports day in a college, the college awarded medals in different categories. 72 medals in Athletics, 24 medals in weightlifting and 36 medals in swimming. If these medals went to a total of 90 persons and only 8 persons got medals in all the three sports, how many received medals in exactly two of these sports?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Set Theory Equations)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yeh Venn diagram ka hardcore mains question hai. Circles banayega toh fans jayega. Isme total medals aur total logon ke beech ka logic formula dimaag me chhapna chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le: Exactly 1 sport wale $= x$, Exactly 2 wale $= y$, aur Exactly 3 wale $= z$. Total Medals ka sum karo. Ab seedha subtract kar de. Boom!

Mathematically :-
$$ Eq 1: x + y + z = 90 \\\\ Eq 2: x + 2y + 3z = 72 + 24 + 36 = 132 \\\\ Eq 2 - Eq 1 \\implies y + 2z = 42 \\\\ z = 8 \\\\ y + 16 = 42 \\\\ y = 26 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Proper venn diagram banake, formula lagao. Bohot lamba padega aur minus-plus me confuse hoke answer galat mark kar dega.

Mathematically :-
$$ n(A \\cup B \\cup C) = \\Sigma n(A) - \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) + n(A \\cap B \\cap C) \\\\ 90 = (72+24+36) - \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) + 8 \\\\ \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) = 132 + 8 - 90 = 50 \\\\ y = \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) - 3n(A \\cap B \\cap C) \\\\ y = 50 - 3(8) = 26 $$

Exam Takeaway: Medals distribution type ke 3-set problem me hamesha 'Sum of Medals' aur 'Sum of Persons' ki 2 linear equations ka setup use karna hai.

questions.q: In an election between two candidates A and B, $8.33\%$ of voters did not cast their vote, and $18.18\%$ of votes of the casted votes were declared invalid. Candidate A gets $31.25\%$ of the votes of total voters and he lost by 100 votes. Find the total number of voters?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (LCM Base Assumption)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, percentages bahut khatarnak diye hain. In sabke fractions denominator me $12, 11, 16$ denge. Inka LCM lekar start karna padega warna decimal me aisi fasaega ki exam hi khatam ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Fractions decode kar aur LCM utha. Khatarnaak bouncer par sixer!

Mathematically :-
$$ Base = LCM(12, 11, 16) = 528 \\\\ Cast = 528 \\times \\frac{11}{12} = 484 \\\\ Valid = 484 \\times \\frac{9}{11} = 396 \\\\ A = 528 \\times \\frac{5}{16} = 165 \\\\ B = 396 - 165 = 231 \\\\ Margin = 231 - 165 = 66 \\\\ 66 \\ units = 100 \\ votes \\\\ Total = 528 \\ units = \\frac{100}{66} \\times 528 = 800 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar $100x$ maan kar chalega ya normal $x$, toh equation raita phaila degi. Never use $x$ for weird percentages.

Mathematically :-
$$ Total = x \\\\ Valid = x \\times \\frac{11}{12} \\times \\frac{9}{11} = \\frac{3x}{4} \\\\ A = \\frac{5x}{16} \\\\ B = \\frac{3x}{4} - \\frac{5x}{16} = \\frac{7x}{16} \\\\ Margin = \\frac{2x}{16} = 100 \\\\ x = 800 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab ajeeb percentages ek hi sequence me ho, unke corresponding fractions ke denominators ka LCM hi sabse best base number hota hai.

questions.q: An employee contributes 20% of their salary to charity. From the remaining amount, 40% is allocated to investments. The rest is divided for education and travel in the ratio 7:5. If the expense on travel is 6,000, what is the employee's total salary?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, lagataar "remaining" chal raha hai, matlab chain method se end tak pohochna hai. End me fraction lagakar value equal kar de.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Total salary 100\% maan. 20\% daan me gaya, bacha 80\%. Ab is 80\% ka 40\% (yani 32\%) invest gaya. Bacha kitna? $80 - 32 = 48\%$. Is 48\% ko Education aur Travel me 7:5 me todna hai. 7+5=12 units. Agar 12 unit = 48\% hai, toh 1 unit = 4\%. Travel ka hissa 5 unit yani $20\%$ hoga. Travel par 6000 lag raha hai. Toh total ka 20\% agar 6000 hai, toh 100\% kitna hoga? Seedha 5 guna kar de = 30000.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Line equation aise banao: $Total \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{5}{12} = 6000$. Ise kaatoge toh direct $Total \times \frac{1}{5} = 6000 \implies Total = 30000$ aayega. Line equation time bachati hai!

**Exam Takeaway:** Jab chain aakhir tak jaye aur absolute value end hisse ki de rakhi ho, toh continuous fraction (Successive) hamesha best hit karta hai.

questions.q: The current population of a district is 9500. If the male population is increased by $14.2 \%$ and the female population is increased by $17.7 \%$, the total population of the district becomes 11003. If out of the total male population $15 \%$ are young boys and out of the total female population $18 \%$ are young girls, then find the difference between the number of young boys and young girls.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dono male aur female $14.2 \%$ toh badhe hi hain. Jo extra $3.5 \%$ ka increase hai wo sirf females ki wajah se total excess me aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Minimum base pakad aur extra value ko compare kar. Junior Satisfaction Method (JSM) se seedha female population aayegi.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Total Increase} = 11003 - 9500 = 1503 \\ \text{Base Increase (if both } 14.2\%) = 9500 \times 14.2 \% = 1349 \\ \text{Extra Increase} = 1503 - 1349 = 154 \\ 3.5 \% \text{ of Females} = 154 \implies \text{Females} = \frac{154 \times 100}{3.5} = 4400 \\ \text{Males} = 9500 - 4400 = 5100 \\ \text{Boys} = 15 \% \text{ of } 5100 = 765 \\ \text{Girls} = 18 \% \text{ of } 4400 = 792 \\ \text{Difference} = 792 - 765 = 27 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable maan ke basic equation bana le par exam me thoda time khayega.

Mathematically :-

$$ M + F = 9500 \\ 1.142 M + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 1.142(9500 - F) + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 10849 - 1.142 F + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 0.035 F = 154 \implies F = 4400, M = 5100 \\ \text{Diff} = (0.18 \times 4400) - (0.15 \times 5100) = 792 - 765 = 27 $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM wahan hamesha lagana jahan total ke do parts ho aur dono ka alag alag percentage change diya ho. Baseline same karke calculation asan ho jati hai.

questions.q: The present population of a village is 15280. If the number of males increases by 25% and the number of females increases by 15%, then the population will become 18428. The difference between present population of males and females in the village is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Total increment $18428 - 15280 = 3148$ ka hua hai. Agar pure gaon ki aabadi sirf 15% se badhti, toh increment kam hota. Ye extra gap sirf un aadmio ke 'extra 10%' ki wajah se hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, seedha JSM chipka. Maan le sab 15% hi badhe.
$$15\% \text{ of } 15280 = 2292$$
Asli me increment $3148$ ka hua. Toh extra kitna aaya? $3148 - 2292 = 856$.
Ye 856 extra aadmio ke 10% ki value hai!
$$10\% \text{ of Males} = 856 \implies \text{Males} = 8560$$
Auraten kitni hui? $15280 - 8560 = 6720$.
Difference $= 8560 - 6720 = 1840$. Seconds me question hawa me! Isme 25% bhi leke kar sakte ho aur easy hoga 4 se kaatne me.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Normal books tujhe $x$ aur $y$ equations ($x+y=15280$, $1.25x+1.15y=18428$) sikhayengi. Usme mat fasna, 2 minute lag jayenge.

Exam Takeaway: Base ko hamesha chote percentage par shift kar diya kar jisse deviation nikal ke easily values mil jaaye.

Final Salary $= 38000 \times 1.1 \times 1.2 \times 0.9$

questions.q: In an examination, a student who gets $20\%$ of the maximum marks fails by 5 marks. Another student who scores $30\%$ of the maximum marks gets 20 marks more than the pass marks. The necessary percentage required for passing is ?

questions.q: The monthly salaries of Arun and Varun are the same. Arun, Varun, and Tarun invest $10 \%$, $8 \%$, and $9 \%$ respectively of their monthly salaries in mutual funds. The difference between the investments of Arun and Varun is Rs. 400. The total investment by Arun and Varun is Rs. 900 more than that of Tarun. What is the monthly salary of Tarun?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Arun aur Varun ki salary same hai, unka investment ka percentage gap $2 \%$ hai jo Rs. 400 ke barabar hai. Yahi se total percentage nikalkar equations ko step-by-step balance karna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Base percentage ko seedha value se equate kar ke relative values nikalo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Since base is same for A & V:} \\ 10 \% - 8 \% = 2 \% \\ 2 \% = 400 \implies 1 \% = 200 \\ \text{Total A & V Inv} = 10 \% + 8 \% = 18 \% \\ 18 \% = 18 \times 200 = 3600 \\ \text{Tarun Inv} = 3600 - 900 = 2700 \\ \text{Now, } 9 \% \text{ of Tarun Salary} = 2700 \\ 1 \% \text{ of Tarun Salary} = 300 \\ \text{Total Salary (100 \%)} = 30000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations me $x$ aur $y$ assign karke solve karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let salary of Arun and Varun} = 100x \\ \text{Let salary of Tarun} = 100y \\ 10x - 8x = 400 \implies 2x = 400 \implies x = 200 \\ 10x + 8x - 9y = 900 \\ 18x - 9y = 900 \\ 18(200) - 9y = 900 \\ 3600 - 900 = 9y \implies 9y = 2700 \implies y = 300 \\ \text{Tarun Salary} = 100y = 100 \times 300 = 30000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Multiple variables hon toh hamesha us link ko pakdo jiska base same ho. Jaise Arun aur Varun ki equal salary di thi toh unka percentage directly subtract ho gaya.

questions.q: In a co-educational school there are 15 more girls than boys. If the number of girls is increased by $10\%$ and the number of boys is also increased by $16\%$, there would be 9 more girls than boys. What is the number of students in the school ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.
Pen-Free Observation : Dekh bhai, difference 15 se 9 ho gaya matlab 6 ka gap boys ne apne extra 6% growth se cover kiya. Sath mein unhone 15 extra girls ka 10% (1.5) bhi nullify kiya hoga. So 6% of Boys is directly 7.5!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Mental Deviation. Mathematically :-

$$ \Delta \text{Diff} = 15 - 9 = 6 \\ 16\% B - 10\% G = 6 \\ 16\% B - 10\% (B + 15) = 6 \\ 6\% B - 1.5 = 6 \\ 6\% B = 7.5 \implies B = 125 \\ \text{Total} = 125 + (125 + 15) = 265 $$


Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2 linear equations ban rahi hain, G ko $(B + 15)$ rakh aur substitution maar ke khatam kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Variable elimination. Mathematically :-
$$1.1(B + 15) - 1.16B = 9$$
$$16.5 - 0.06B = 9$$
$$0.06B = 7.5 \Rightarrow B = 125$$
$$Total = 125 + (125+15) = 265$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Base assumptions from options. Mathematically :-
$$Total = 265$$
$$G + B = 265 \text{ and } G - B = 15$$
$$G = 140, B = 125$$
$$140 \times 1.1 - 125 \times 1.16 = 154 - 145 = 9$$

Exam Takeaway: Option split karke mentally verify karna linear equations se bhi fast hota hai kai baar.

questions.q: A fraction in reduced form is such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $25\%$ and the denominator is reduced to $80\%$ it results in $\frac{5}{8}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction par percentage operations sidha unke multipliers se likhe jaane chahiye. Increase $25\%$ means $5/4$, and reduced to $80\%$ means $4/5$. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le original fraction $\frac{N}{D}$ hai. Isko square kiya toh bana $\frac{N^2}{D^2}$. Numerator ko $25\%$ badhaya yani $\frac{5}{4}$ kiya. Denominator ko $80\%$ kar diya yani $\frac{4}{5}$ kiya. Naya fraction bana: $\frac{(\frac{5}{4}) N^2}{(\frac{4}{5}) D^2} = \frac{25}{16} \frac{N^2}{D^2}$. Question kehta hai ki ye value original fraction ka $\frac{5}{8}$ hai. Toh equate kar de: $\frac{25}{16} \frac{N^2}{D^2} = \frac{5}{8} \frac{N}{D}$. Ek $\frac{N}{D}$ cancel ho gaya. Bacha $\frac{N}{D} = \frac{5}{8} \times \frac{16}{25} = \frac{2}{5}$. Toh apna original fraction $\frac{2}{5}$ tha. Numerator $\times$ Denominator = $2 \times 5 = 10$. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables le kar lamba karega toh equation ulajh jayegi. Cancel out as soon as possible. Exam Takeaway: "Reduced TO" aur "Reduced BY" ka language dhyan se padha kar. Yahan reduced TO $80\%$ tha, yani direct $4/5$ lagana hai.
OperationMultiplier
Numerator $+25\%$$5/4$
Denominator to $80\%$$4/5$

questions.q: The production of bottles rose to 26000 from 16000 in 2 years. Find the rate of growth per annum.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2 saal ka case hai toh initial aur final value ke ratio ka square root lena hoga. Ratio $26000/16000 = 1.625$. $1.25$ ka square $1.56$ hota hai aur $1.30$ ka $1.69$. Uske beech me aayega, aur option dekh kar seedha exact approximation laga de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Ratio nikal kar approximate root target kar.

Mathematically :-
$$Ratio = \frac{26000}{16000} = \frac{26}{16} = 1.625 \\\\ \sqrt{1.625} \approx 1.2747 \\\\ Rate = (1.2747 - 1) \times 100 = 27.47\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Compound interest amount wala basic formula use kar.

Mathematically :-
$$16000(1 + \frac{R}{100})^2 = 26000 \\\\ (1 + \frac{R}{100})^2 = \frac{26}{16} = 1.625 \\\\ 1 + \frac{R}{100} = 1.2747 \\\\ R = 27.47$$

Exam Takeaway: Exact root nikalne me paseene chhut jayenge. Compound interest aur growth ke sawaalo me square roots hamesha approximation se estimate karo.

questions.q: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of $2,60,000$ is increasing at a rate of $25\%$ every year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $25\% = \frac{1}{4}$. Yani difference hamesha picchli values ka wahi percentage hoga. Sab values ko pura multiply mat kar dena!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse scaling maar. Smart step ne bohot time bacha liya! Mathematically :- $$ P_3 \times \left(\frac{5}{4}\right)^3 = 2,60,000 \\ P_3 \times \frac{125}{64} = 2,60,000 \implies P_3 = 1,33,120 \\ \text{Difference} = 25\% \text{ of } P_3 \\ = \frac{1}{4} \times 1,33,120 = 33,280 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Baccho ki tarah normal tree se subtraction. Mathematically :- $$ P_3 = 1,33,120 \\ P_2 = 1,33,120 \times 1.25 = 1,66,400 \\ P_2 - P_3 = 1,66,400 - 1,33,120 = 33,280 $$

Exam Takeaway: Consecutive years ka difference hamesha base saal ka percentage change value hi hota hai. Is logic se extra steps hat jate hain.

BaseSuccessive Chain Logic

questions.q: A quality control officer tracks the defect rates in 4 different machines in a textile factory. The first machine produces fabrics with an average defect rate of 1.8\%, the second with 2.4\%, and the third with 1.6\%. The fourth machine operated for 5 fewer hours than the average runtime of the first three, yet its total defective output was 0.92 units. If the total number of defective units from all four machines is 4.12, and each machine's total production was identical, find the defect percentage of the fourth machine. (SSC CHSL TIER I - 21/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling (Equating imaginary units to real values) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sabhi 4 machines ka total defect 4.12 hai aur 4th wale ka akela 0.92 hai. Yaani bache hue pehle 3 machines ne milkar 4.12 - 0.92 = 3.2 defective units banaye. Un teeno ka combined percentage 1.8 + 2.4 + 1.6 = 5.8\% hai. Ab agar 3.2 units seedha 5.8\% ko represent kar rahe hain, toh 0.92 units kitne percentage ko represent karega? Total production nikalne ki jarurat hi nahi hai, direct cross-multiply maar! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bina production P nikaley direct units ko percentage se scale kar do. Mathematically :-
$3.2 \text{ units} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} 5.8\%$
$1 \text{ unit} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} \frac{5.8}{3.2}\%$
$0.92 \text{ units} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} \left(\frac{5.8}{3.2}\right) \times 0.92 = 1.6675\% \approx 1.67\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total production P maan kar solve karna. Yeh tab theek hai jab ghar pe practice kar rahe ho. Mathematically :-
$P \times (1.8\% + 2.4\% + 1.6\%) = 4.12 - 0.92$
$P \times 5.8\% = 3.20 \implies P = \frac{320}{5.8}$
$\text{Defect \% of 4th} = \left(\frac{0.92}{P}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{0.92 \times 5.8}{320}\right) \times 100 = 1.6675\% \approx 1.67\%$ Exam Takeaway: Jab "total production identical" likha ho, toh units aur percentage directly proportional hote hain. P nikalne par time waste mat kar. Always use the Ratio/Unitary method to jump straight to the answer!
Concept TrickMathematical Shortcut
Direct Proportionality (Production is Constant)$\text{Target \%} = \left( \frac{\text{Total \% of known group}}{\text{Total Units of known group}} \right) \times \text{Units of Target}$

questions.q: The total number of male and female population in a city increased by 25% from 1970 to 1980. During the same period, the male population increased by 40% while the female population increased by 20%. From 1980 to 1990, the female population increased by 25%. In 1990, if the female population is twice the male population, then the percentage increase in the total of male and female population in the city from 1970 to 1990 is.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, individual growth (M=40, F=20) aur overall (25) ek sath dekhte hi deemag mein alligation bajna chahiye. Ratio $1:3$ aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Alligation se base ratio nikal kar numbers assume kar. Mathematically :-

$\text{Alligation (1970): } M(40) \text{ & } F(20) \rightarrow Mix(25)$

$\text{Ratio } M:F = (25-20):(40-25) = 5:15 = 1:3$

$ \text{Let } 1970: M=100, F=300 \Rightarrow \text{Total } = 400$

$\text{In } 1980: M = 140, F = 360$

$\text{In } 1990: F = 360 \times 1.25 = 450$

$M = \frac{450}{2} = 225 \Rightarrow \text{Total } 1990 = 675$

$\text{Inc } = \frac{675 - 400}{400} \times 100 = \frac{275}{4} = 68.75\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable based alligation equations likh. Mathematically :-

$\frac{0.4M + 0.2F}{M+F} = 0.25$

$0.4M + 0.2F = 0.25M + 0.25F \Rightarrow 0.15M = 0.05F \Rightarrow F = 3M$

$\text{1980}: M_1 = 1.4M, F_1 = 1.2(3M) = 3.6M$

$\text{1990}: F_2 = 1.25(3.6M) = 4.5M$

$M_2 = \frac{4.5M}{2} = 2.25M$

$\text{Total}_{1990} = 4.5M + 2.25M = 6.75M$

$\text{Inc} = \frac{6.75M - 4M}{4M} = \frac{2.75}{4} = 68.75\%$

Exam Takeaway: Jaha bhi combine average aur individual averages diye hon, Alligation method ko bina soche apply maar diya kar.

List IList II
Alligation Rule$\frac{N_1}{N_2} = \frac{A_m - A_2}{A_1 - A_m}$

What should be the percentage decrease in his fuel efficiency for city driving over non-city driving, so that he just completes his entire journey without a refill?

Mathematically :-
$$ NC_{dist} = 18\\% + 24\\% = 42\\% \\\\ NC_{fuel} = 12\\% + 16\\% = 28\\% \\\\ E_{NC} = \\frac{42}{28} = \\frac{3}{2} \\\\ C_{dist} = 58\\%, \\ C_{fuel} = 72\\% \\\\ E_{C} = \\frac{58}{72} = \\frac{29}{36} \\\\ \\% \\Delta = \\frac{\\frac{3}{2} - \\frac{29}{36}}{\\frac{3}{2}} \\times 100 = 46.29\\% $$

Mathematically :-

questions_hin.q_hi: The price of an article decreased by 8% every year. If the difference between the price at the end of the third and fourth year is 69, then 40% of the price at the end of the second year is?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: 3rd aur 4th year ke beech ka difference purely 3rd year ki value ka 8% hi toh hoga! Piche calculate karna hai (reverse successive). Digital sum ya multiples check kar sakte ho, par calculation aasan hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $8\% \text{ of } P_3 = 69 \implies P_3 = \frac{6900}{8}$. Ab $P_3$ aaya kaise? $P_2$ me 8% ghata ke, yaani $P_2 \times 0.92 = P_3$. Toh $P_2 = \frac{6900}{8 \times 0.92}$. Humein $40\%$ (yaani 0.4) of $P_2$ chahiye: $0.4 \times \frac{6900}{8 \times 0.92} = 375$. Calculation ko end tak hold kar!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let starting price be P. $P_3 = P \times (0.92)^3$. Difference $P_3 - P_4 = P_3 - P_3(0.92) = P_3(0.08) = 69$. Step by step nikalne me time waste hota hai, seedha reverse shift lagao.

Best Exam Approach: Method 1, combined with intermediate step skipping.

questions_hin.q_hi: Vikas has Rs.x. He gave 44.44% of Rs.x to Anju. Anju bought 33.33% of the money she got from Vikas for a dress and donated 31.25% of the remaining amount. The remaining amount is saved by (y). If the amount donated is 1250, then find the value of (x-y).
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Ye pure fraction chain ka chakkar hai. $44.44\% = \frac{4}{9}$, $33.33\% = \frac{1}{3}$, aur $31.25\% = \frac{5}{16}$. Branches ko pakad ke bas link karta ja!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, sequence utha le: Anju ko mila $\frac{4}{9}x$.
Dress pe uda diye $\frac{1}{3}$, bache hue $\frac{2}{3}$.
Toh Remaining amount aaya $= \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{4}{9}x = \frac{8}{27}x$.
Donation hua $31.25\%$ yani remaining ka $\frac{5}{16}$ part.
Donation $= \frac{5}{16} \times \frac{8}{27}x = \frac{5}{54}x$. Aur yehi 1250 hai.
$\frac{5}{54}x = 1250 \implies x = 13500$.
Ab Save $(y)$ hua bacha hua $\frac{11}{16}$ hissa.
$y = \frac{11}{16} \times \frac{8}{27}x = \frac{11}{54}x$.
Value rakh $y = \frac{11}{54} \times 13500 = 2750$.
Pucha kya hai? $x - y = 13500 - 2750 = 10750$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek bade percentage wale lambaue sawal ko tu single equation ratios me baant sakta hai jo tezi se cancel ho jaati hai.

Exam Takeaway: Ajeeb fractions jaise $31.25\% = 5 \times 6.25\% = \frac{5}{16}$ rate hue hone chahiye warna waqt bekar kharab hoga.

questions_hin.q_hi: The population of a town is 3,11,250. The ratio of women to men is 43:40. If there are 24% literate among men and 8% literate among women, the total number of literate persons in the town is?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Weighted Average

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Pura lamba chauda number 3,11,250 dekh ke darna mat. Ratio dekho: Total 83 parts = 311250. 83 ek prime hai, toh pakka perfectly katega. Base value nikal aur apply kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... W = 43x, M = 40x. Total 83x = 311250 $\implies$ x = 3750 (unit digit se hint le, $3 \times 5 = 15$). Literate Men = $24\%$ of $40x = 9.6x$. Literate Women = $8\%$ of $43x = 3.44x$. Total literate = $13.04x$. Total = $13.04 \times 3750 = 48900$. Digital Sum check: 13.04 (DS=8) * 3750 (DS=6) = 48 -> DS=3. Options me check kar, 48900 ka DS = 4+8+9=21 -> 3. Match!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard tarika yahi hai bas bacche pehle population ko exact men/women me todte hain, phir percentage nikalte hain. Wo 'Maha-Paap' hai.

Future Exam Takeaway: Variables (x) me hi percentage calculate kar aur end me multiply kar. CDS me time bachana hi asli game hai!

questions_hin.q_hi: The monthly salary of a person was $50,000$. He used to spend on Family expenses (E), Taxes (T), Charity (C), and the rest were his savings. E was $60\%$ of the income, T was $20\%$ of E, and C was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T becomes $30\%$ of E and C becomes $20\%$ of T. The difference between the two savings (in Rs)?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, lag raha hai bada question hai par yaha multiple base aur sub-percentages hain. Digital sum lagane se accha single percentage me inko sum up karke udaya jaye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Tree bna ke calculation simple rakh. Sub-percentages ko add karke ek combined multiplier nikal le. Mathematically :- $$ S_1 = [100\% - (60\% + 12\% + 1.8\%)] \times 50000 \\ S_1 = 26.2\% \times 50000 = 13100 \\ \text{New Inc} = 140\% \times 50000 = 70000 \\ S_2 = [100\% - (60\% + 18\% + 3.6\%)] \times 70000 \\ S_2 = 18.4\% \times 70000 = 12880 \\ \text{Diff} = 13100 - 12880 = 220 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute rupees me convert karega toh lamba process hoga. Ye approach error-prone hai. Mathematically :- $$ E_1 = 30000 \implies T_1 = 6000 \implies C_1 = 900 \implies S_1 = 50000 - 36900 = 13100 \\ E_2 = 42000 \implies T_2 = 12600 \implies C_2 = 2520 \implies S_2 = 70000 - 57120 = 12880 \\ \text{Diff} = 13100 - 12880 = 220 $$

Exam Takeaway: Sub-percentages ko seedha unki parent percentages pe multiply karke base level pe add kar lene se equation ekdum patli ho jati hai.

B. New Savings2. $100\% - (60\% + 18\% + 3.6\%) = 18.4\%$

questions_hin.q_hi: Kartik saves $20 \%$ of his monthly income while he spends the remaining amount on food, rent, education, and shopping. He spends $15 \%$ of his income on food, while Rs. 12,800 is spent on rent, Rs. 32,000 on education, and Rs. 7,200 on shopping. The amount spent on shopping is $11.25 \%$ of the total expenditure. How much money (in Rs.) is spent on food?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dhyan de bhai, Shopping total expenditure ka $11.25 \%$ diya hai. Aur $11.25 \%$ fraction me $9/80$ hota hai. Waha se directly total expenditure aayega jisko reverse use karke Food ki value mil jayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Given percentage se independent unit nikalo, baki extra values faltu hain unko ignore karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Shopping} = 11.25 \% \text{ of Total Expenditure} \\ 7200 = \frac{9}{80} \times \text{Total Exp.} \\ \text{Total Exp.} = \frac{7200 \times 80}{9} = 64000 \\ \text{Savings} = 20 \%, \text{ so Exp.} = 80 \% \text{ of Income} \\ 80 \% \text{ of Income} = 64000 \implies 100 \% \text{ Income} = 80000 \\ \text{Food Spend} = 15 \% \text{ of } 80000 = 12000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional setup banakar variables dhundo par concept wahi rahega.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Income} = I \\ \text{Expenditure} = 0.8 I \\ \text{Shopping} = 0.1125 \times (0.8 I) = 7200 \\ \frac{1125}{10000} \times 0.8 I = 7200 \\ \frac{9}{80} \times \frac{4}{5} I = 7200 \\ \frac{36}{400} I = 7200 \implies I = \frac{7200 \times 400}{36} = 80000 \\ \text{Food} = 0.15 \times 80000 = 12000 $$

questions_hin.q_hi: After sports day in a college, the college awarded medals in different categories. 72 medals in Athletics, 24 medals in weightlifting and 36 medals in swimming. If these medals went to a total of 90 persons and only 8 persons got medals in all the three sports, how many received medals in exactly two of these sports?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Set Theory Equations)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yeh Venn diagram ka hardcore mains question hai. Circles banayega toh fans jayega. Isme total medals aur total logon ke beech ka logic formula dimaag me chhapna chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le: Exactly 1 sport wale $= x$, Exactly 2 wale $= y$, aur Exactly 3 wale $= z$. Total Medals ka sum karo. Ab seedha subtract kar de. Boom!

Mathematically :-
$$ Eq 1: x + y + z = 90 \\\\ Eq 2: x + 2y + 3z = 72 + 24 + 36 = 132 \\\\ Eq 2 - Eq 1 \\implies y + 2z = 42 \\\\ z = 8 \\\\ y + 16 = 42 \\\\ y = 26 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Proper venn diagram banake, formula lagao. Bohot lamba padega aur minus-plus me confuse hoke answer galat mark kar dega.

Mathematically :-
$$ n(A \\cup B \\cup C) = \\Sigma n(A) - \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) + n(A \\cap B \\cap C) \\\\ 90 = (72+24+36) - \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) + 8 \\\\ \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) = 132 + 8 - 90 = 50 \\\\ y = \\Sigma n(A \\cap B) - 3n(A \\cap B \\cap C) \\\\ y = 50 - 3(8) = 26 $$

Exam Takeaway: Medals distribution type ke 3-set problem me hamesha 'Sum of Medals' aur 'Sum of Persons' ki 2 linear equations ka setup use karna hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: In an election between two candidates A and B, $8.33\%$ of voters did not cast their vote, and $18.18\%$ of votes of the casted votes were declared invalid. Candidate A gets $31.25\%$ of the votes of total voters and he lost by 100 votes. Find the total number of voters?

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Fractions decode kar aur LCM utha. Khatarnaak bouncer par sixer!

Mathematically :-
$$ Base = LCM(12, 11, 16) = 528 \\\\ Cast = 528 \\times \\frac{11}{12} = 484 \\\\ Valid = 484 \\times \\frac{9}{11} = 396 \\\\ A = 528 \\times \\frac{5}{16} = 165 \\\\ B = 396 - 165 = 231 \\\\ Margin = 231 - 165 = 66 \\\\ 66 \\ units = 100 \\ votes \\\\ Total = 528 \\ units = \\frac{100}{66} \\times 528 = 800 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar $100x$ maan kar chalega ya normal $x$, toh equation raita phaila degi. Never use $x$ for weird percentages.

Mathematically :-
$$ Total = x \\\\ Valid = x \\times \\frac{11}{12} \\times \\frac{9}{11} = \\frac{3x}{4} \\\\ A = \\frac{5x}{16} \\\\ B = \\frac{3x}{4} - \\frac{5x}{16} = \\frac{7x}{16} \\\\ Margin = \\frac{2x}{16} = 100 \\\\ x = 800 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab ajeeb percentages ek hi sequence me ho, unke corresponding fractions ke denominators ka LCM hi sabse best base number hota hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: The current population of a district is 9500. If the male population is increased by $14.2 \%$ and the female population is increased by $17.7 \%$, the total population of the district becomes 11003. If out of the total male population $15 \%$ are young boys and out of the total female population $18 \%$ are young girls, then find the difference between the number of young boys and young girls.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dono male aur female $14.2 \%$ toh badhe hi hain. Jo extra $3.5 \%$ ka increase hai wo sirf females ki wajah se total excess me aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Minimum base pakad aur extra value ko compare kar. Junior Satisfaction Method (JSM) se seedha female population aayegi.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Total Increase} = 11003 - 9500 = 1503 \\ \text{Base Increase (if both } 14.2\%) = 9500 \times 14.2 \% = 1349 \\ \text{Extra Increase} = 1503 - 1349 = 154 \\ 3.5 \% \text{ of Females} = 154 \implies \text{Females} = \frac{154 \times 100}{3.5} = 4400 \\ \text{Males} = 9500 - 4400 = 5100 \\ \text{Boys} = 15 \% \text{ of } 5100 = 765 \\ \text{Girls} = 18 \% \text{ of } 4400 = 792 \\ \text{Difference} = 792 - 765 = 27 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable maan ke basic equation bana le par exam me thoda time khayega.

Mathematically :-

$$ M + F = 9500 \\ 1.142 M + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 1.142(9500 - F) + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 10849 - 1.142 F + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 0.035 F = 154 \implies F = 4400, M = 5100 \\ \text{Diff} = (0.18 \times 4400) - (0.15 \times 5100) = 792 - 765 = 27 $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM wahan hamesha lagana jahan total ke do parts ho aur dono ka alag alag percentage change diya ho. Baseline same karke calculation asan ho jati hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: In an examination, a student who gets $20\%$ of the maximum marks fails by 5 marks. Another student who scores $30\%$ of the maximum marks gets 20 marks more than the pass marks. The necessary percentage required for passing is ?

Agar 25 marks ka $10\%$ banta hai, toh 5 marks banenge $(10/25) \times 5 = 2\%$. Pehla baccha 5 marks se fail hua tha, yani usko pass hone ke liye $2\%$ aur chahiye the. questions_hin.q_hi: The monthly salaries of Arun and Varun are the same. Arun, Varun, and Tarun invest $10 \%$, $8 \%$, and $9 \%$ respectively of their monthly salaries in mutual funds. The difference between the investments of Arun and Varun is Rs. 400. The total investment by Arun and Varun is Rs. 900 more than that of Tarun. What is the monthly salary of Tarun?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Arun aur Varun ki salary same hai, unka investment ka percentage gap $2 \%$ hai jo Rs. 400 ke barabar hai. Yahi se total percentage nikalkar equations ko step-by-step balance karna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Base percentage ko seedha value se equate kar ke relative values nikalo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Since base is same for A & V:} \\ 10 \% - 8 \% = 2 \% \\ 2 \% = 400 \implies 1 \% = 200 \\ \text{Total A & V Inv} = 10 \% + 8 \% = 18 \% \\ 18 \% = 18 \times 200 = 3600 \\ \text{Tarun Inv} = 3600 - 900 = 2700 \\ \text{Now, } 9 \% \text{ of Tarun Salary} = 2700 \\ 1 \% \text{ of Tarun Salary} = 300 \\ \text{Total Salary (100 \%)} = 30000 $$

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let salary of Arun and Varun} = 100x \\ \text{Let salary of Tarun} = 100y \\ 10x - 8x = 400 \implies 2x = 400 \implies x = 200 \\ 10x + 8x - 9y = 900 \\ 18x - 9y = 900 \\ 18(200) - 9y = 900 \\ 3600 - 900 = 9y \implies 9y = 2700 \implies y = 300 \\ \text{Tarun Salary} = 100y = 100 \times 300 = 30000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Multiple variables hon toh hamesha us link ko pakdo jiska base same ho. Jaise Arun aur Varun ki equal salary di thi toh unka percentage directly subtract ho gaya.

questions_hin.q_hi: A fraction in reduced form is such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $25\%$ and the denominator is reduced to $80\%$ it results in $\frac{5}{8}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is:
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction par percentage operations sidha unke multipliers se likhe jaane chahiye. Increase $25\%$ means $5/4$, and reduced to $80\%$ means $4/5$. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le original fraction $\frac{N}{D}$ hai. Isko square kiya toh bana $\frac{N^2}{D^2}$. Numerator ko $25\%$ badhaya yani $\frac{5}{4}$ kiya. Denominator ko $80\%$ kar diya yani $\frac{4}{5}$ kiya. Naya fraction bana: $\frac{(\frac{5}{4}) N^2}{(\frac{4}{5}) D^2} = \frac{25}{16} \frac{N^2}{D^2}$. Question kehta hai ki ye value original fraction ka $\frac{5}{8}$ hai. Toh equate kar de: $\frac{25}{16} \frac{N^2}{D^2} = \frac{5}{8} \frac{N}{D}$. Ek $\frac{N}{D}$ cancel ho gaya. Bacha $\frac{N}{D} = \frac{5}{8} \times \frac{16}{25} = \frac{2}{5}$. Toh apna original fraction $\frac{2}{5}$ tha. Numerator $\times$ Denominator = $2 \times 5 = 10$. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables le kar lamba karega toh equation ulajh jayegi. Cancel out as soon as possible. Exam Takeaway: "Reduced TO" aur "Reduced BY" ka language dhyan se padha kar. Yahan reduced TO $80\%$ tha, yani direct $4/5$ lagana hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of $2,60,000$ is increasing at a rate of $25\%$ every year?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $25\% = \frac{1}{4}$. Yani difference hamesha picchli values ka wahi percentage hoga. Sab values ko pura multiply mat kar dena!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse scaling maar. Smart step ne bohot time bacha liya! Mathematically :- $$ P_3 \times \left(\frac{5}{4}\right)^3 = 2,60,000 \\ P_3 \times \frac{125}{64} = 2,60,000 \implies P_3 = 1,33,120 \\ \text{Difference} = 25\% \text{ of } P_3 \\ = \frac{1}{4} \times 1,33,120 = 33,280 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Baccho ki tarah normal tree se subtraction. Mathematically :- $$ P_3 = 1,33,120 \\ P_2 = 1,33,120 \times 1.25 = 1,66,400 \\ P_2 - P_3 = 1,66,400 - 1,33,120 = 33,280 $$

Exam Takeaway: Consecutive years ka difference hamesha base saal ka percentage change value hi hota hai. Is logic se extra steps hat jate hain.

questions_hin.q_hi: A quality control officer tracks the defect rates in 4 different machines in a textile factory. The first machine produces fabrics with an average defect rate of 1.8\%, the second with 2.4\%, and the third with 1.6\%. The fourth machine operated for 5 fewer hours than the average runtime of the first three, yet its total defective output was 0.92 units. If the total number of defective units from all four machines is 4.12, and each machine's total production was identical, find the defect percentage of the fourth machine. (SSC CHSL TIER I - 21/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling (Equating imaginary units to real values) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sabhi 4 machines ka total defect 4.12 hai aur 4th wale ka akela 0.92 hai. Yaani bache hue pehle 3 machines ne milkar 4.12 - 0.92 = 3.2 defective units banaye. Un teeno ka combined percentage 1.8 + 2.4 + 1.6 = 5.8\% hai. Ab agar 3.2 units seedha 5.8\% ko represent kar rahe hain, toh 0.92 units kitne percentage ko represent karega? Total production nikalne ki jarurat hi nahi hai, direct cross-multiply maar! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bina production P nikaley direct units ko percentage se scale kar do. Mathematically :-
$3.2 \text{ units} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} 5.8\%$
$1 \text{ unit} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} \frac{5.8}{3.2}\%$
$0.92 \text{ units} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} \left(\frac{5.8}{3.2}\right) \times 0.92 = 1.6675\% \approx 1.67\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total production P maan kar solve karna. Yeh tab theek hai jab ghar pe practice kar rahe ho. Mathematically :-
$P \times (1.8\% + 2.4\% + 1.6\%) = 4.12 - 0.92$
$P \times 5.8\% = 3.20 \implies P = \frac{320}{5.8}$
$\text{Defect \% of 4th} = \left(\frac{0.92}{P}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{0.92 \times 5.8}{320}\right) \times 100 = 1.6675\% \approx 1.67\%$ Exam Takeaway: Jab "total production identical" likha ho, toh units aur percentage directly proportional hote hain. P nikalne par time waste mat kar. Always use the Ratio/Unitary method to jump straight to the answer!
Concept TrickMathematical Shortcut
Direct Proportionality (Production is Constant)$\text{Target \%} = \left( \frac{\text{Total \% of known group}}{\text{Total Units of known group}} \right) \times \text{Units of Target}$

questions_hin.q_hi: The total number of male and female population in a city increased by 25% from 1970 to 1980. During the same period, the male population increased by 40% while the female population increased by 20%. From 1980 to 1990, the female population increased by 25%. In 1990, if the female population is twice the male population, then the percentage increase in the total of male and female population in the city from 1970 to 1990 is.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, individual growth (M=40, F=20) aur overall (25) ek sath dekhte hi deemag mein alligation bajna chahiye. Ratio $1:3$ aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Alligation se base ratio nikal kar numbers assume kar. Mathematically :-

$\text{Alligation (1970): } M(40) \text{ & } F(20) \rightarrow Mix(25)$

$\text{Ratio } M:F = (25-20):(40-25) = 5:15 = 1:3$

$ \text{Let } 1970: M=100, F=300 \Rightarrow \text{Total } = 400$

$\text{In } 1980: M = 140, F = 360$

$\text{In } 1990: F = 360 \times 1.25 = 450$

$M = \frac{450}{2} = 225 \Rightarrow \text{Total } 1990 = 675$

$\text{Inc } = \frac{675 - 400}{400} \times 100 = \frac{275}{4} = 68.75\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable based alligation equations likh. Mathematically :-

$\frac{0.4M + 0.2F}{M+F} = 0.25$

$0.4M + 0.2F = 0.25M + 0.25F \Rightarrow 0.15M = 0.05F \Rightarrow F = 3M$

$\text{1980}: M_1 = 1.4M, F_1 = 1.2(3M) = 3.6M$

$\text{1990}: F_2 = 1.25(3.6M) = 4.5M$

$M_2 = \frac{4.5M}{2} = 2.25M$

$\text{Total}_{1990} = 4.5M + 2.25M = 6.75M$

$\text{Inc} = \frac{6.75M - 4M}{4M} = \frac{2.75}{4} = 68.75\%$

Exam Takeaway: Jaha bhi combine average aur individual averages diye hon, Alligation method ko bina soche apply maar diya kar.
